variations_text: Eight variations baked again at 1254 dots on the NEW default; colour group now (before): v1 new seeds 0.811 (0.765); v2 more moss 0.700 (0.760); v3 heavily damaged 0.761 (0.733); v4 faded sun-bleached 0.694 (0.554); v5 fresh and clean 0.534 (0.463); v6 dark and wet 0.693 (0.550); v7 pale old 0.591 (0.544); v8 big slates 0.732 (0.746). v1, v3, v7, v8 keep their settings (the look checker said they were good). v2, v4, v5 and v6 got new settings after 17 small colour-only test bakes at 512 dots (the look checker's advice tried first, then my own variants, judged by eye; sheets in variations/tuning_512/): v2 moss coverage 0.62 with patchiness 0.5, lichen 0.3 and rim_opacity 0.7 (the advice alone was not enough because the default's moss rose from 0.22 to 0.30); v4 bleach_amount 1.0, bleach_cover 0.55, patch_size 0.6, no damp stain, tone_centre 4.6, tint_amount 0.5, patch_tint 0.3; v5 fade 0.6, streak_contrast 0.9, tone_spread 0.3, no outliers, tint 0.35, patch_tint 0.2; v6 tone_centre 3.0, stain_amount 0.6, stain_cover 0.4, patch_size 0.3. Old settings and scores are kept in variations.json under "before the look fixes". Honest reading: v6 no longer looks burnt and every slate outline reads; v5 is even but keeps paint streaks; v2 is clearly a damp mossy roof; v4 is the weakest, it still reads mostly as a lighter greyer tile. The scores moved with both the settings and the new default, so a variation's before and after is not a clean comparison.
seed_spread_text: Default settings with five sets of seeds, colour group now (before): default seeds 0.822 (0.701), v1 0.811 (0.765), seeds b 0.824 (0.769), seeds c 0.802 (0.753), seeds d 0.792 (0.710). Mean 0.810 (0.740), lowest 0.792 (0.701), highest 0.824 (0.769), spread 0.032 (0.068). The default seeds are no longer the lowest. Feature size is 0.90 to 0.96 on every set (0.45 to 0.88 before), so the gain is not a lucky draw, but about three quarters of the colour gain (78 %) is that one cliff measure.
area_text: 2 x 2 area (2508 dots, colour and height) baked again, 1344 s on a very busy machine (522 s before at lower load). Quarter colour groups 0.831 / 0.795 / 0.804 / 0.805 (before 0.701 / 0.751 / 0.705 / 0.752). By eye: continuous roof, no seam, no visible repeat; the straight-edged paint facets are visible on many slates. The 4 x 4 area was not baked again and is marked before the look fixes in the README.
